_comment: Ratchet baseline for check_no_app_names.py. These counts may only go DOWN. The target for all four is zero: content reaches it at extraction (stage 7), imports at the AppSpec seams (stage 4), home_path_sites when every path in $HOME comes from config. `watched` is sticky on purpose, so an app that leaves the catalog is still scanned for leftovers; it names this installation's apps, so it is kept in .runtime/no_app_names_watched.json. NOTE 2026-08-27: content/imports/literals were re-pinned at a HIGHER measured value on this date, once, because the scan area was widened from six directories to the tracked tree and an app-content file stopped short-circuiting out of all four checks. Nobody added those lines; the gate could not previously see them. See `raised` below for the full reason, which prints on every run until each count comes back down.
